verification_steps: Observe that before the fix, `serialize_response(response, skip_defaults=True)` returns `{"name": "Ada", "note": None}`, raising an AssertionError.

Observe that after changing `serialize_response` to return `response.dict(skip_defaults=skip_defaults)`, `serialize_response(response, skip_defaults=True)` returns `{"name": "Ada"}` and `serialize_response(response, skip_defaults=False)` returns `{"name": "Ada", "note": None}`, passing all assertions.
